Container.Name: storage-exporter
Container.Overview: Tiny sidecar that reads Unraid's own cached array/disk status (/var/local/emhttp/disks.ini) every 30s and writes per-disk temperature, capacity used/free/percent, and cumulative read/write/error counters to InfluxDB (measurement "storage_disk"), plus an array-wide capacity rollup (measurement "storage_array"). Reads emhttp's already-cached values only - never spins up sleeping disks or runs smartctl directly. Entrypoint overridden to run /storage-stats.sh instead of Glances itself.
Container.Requires: Requires the "monitoring" Docker network, an influxdb container reachable at hostname "influxdb" on that network, and the script at /mnt/user/appdata/glances/scripts/storage-stats.sh on the host.

Config.Name: Script
Config.Description: Parses disks.ini -> InfluxDB line protocol via curl
